categoryDefinitions.GENERAL: ordinary goods that need no temperature control or special permits
categoryDefinitions.COLD_CHAIN: goods that must stay within a set temperature range, such as vaccines, medicines and fresh food
categoryDefinitions.CONTROLLED: regulated or dangerous goods that need a controlled goods declaration and a safety data sheet, such as lithium batteries, chemicals and flammable or pressurised materials

questions.prompt: The declared cargo categories match what the cargo description says the goods are.
The safety data sheet and the controlled goods declaration describe the same goods as the cargo description.
Which risk signal does the warehouse inspection note show?

options.no_risk: No packaging damage or temperature risk is described
options.damaged_packaging: Physical damage to the packaging is described
options.cold_chain_risk: Temperature control appears compromised without physical damage

questions.prompt: Nothing in the customer's written instructions forbids or restricts the planned route and handover.
